package day2.part2;

public class MissingNumInArray {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		int [] arrNum = new int[5];
		arrNum[0] = 1;
		arrNum[1] = 2;
		arrNum[2] = 4;
		arrNum[3] = 5;
		arrNum[4] = 6;
		int Sum = 0;
		int TotalNum = 6;//this value is 6 as last element of array is 6
		for(int Iter =0;Iter<arrNum.length; Iter++)
		{
			Sum = Sum + arrNum[Iter];
					
		}
		int expNum = TotalNum*(TotalNum+1)/2;
		int Ans = expNum - Sum;
		System.out.println(Ans);
		
		
	}

}
